scope: Complete finite first contact on the D6+A1+A1 edge from the certified E7+A1+A1 corner. All ten safe primitive norms, every integral finite-angle profile and every relative norm-one orbit interval are included. The rational boost is not an E8 lattice automorphism; every candidate is pulled back and tested in the actual lattice. Certified PARI norm/unit completeness is inherited explicitly. No full-volume or conjugacy claim.
